components.name: Relation-conditioned witness precision for radical-support collapse
components.project_addition: Use radical as an explicit finite multiplicative-support collapse; expose the forgotten multiplicity residual with exact integer coordinates; separate witness existence radius, arithmetic absorption floor, floor-access radius and the full norm/absorption Pareto frontier; derive and compress the absorption floor through exterior/determinantal, support/valuation, prime-local and block-image coordinates; treat Pasten's residual-product divisibility and valuation-exponent sensitivity as adopted prior art; decompose unit relations into principal derivative-image ideals and blockwise access problems; transport general positive-row signed L-infinity access by y=r*1-x into a bounded numerical-semigroup defect problem; encode eventual access through an Apéry profile; then compress the tail-certification language from raw L-infinity factorization radii L_j to q_j=ceil(L_j/2), with a finite exception table completing the entire nonnegative access function. Numerical-semigroup p-length, Apéry, eventual quasipolynomial behavior and nonminimal-generator factorization statistics are treated as prior art, not P025 discoveries. P023 generic query-generated repair and A3/A4 Pareto-antichain semantics remain upstream mother structures.
